description: Na₃SnCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.68 Å. Sn is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.70 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.32 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Sn, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one P atom.
